title: Automatic bank sync, opt-in and encrypted
summary: An AI assistant proposes automatic bank sync that stays off until you turn it on in Settings. Your device downloads new transactions straight from your bank; when your phone and laptop share them, they travel end-to-end encrypted, and manual entry stays the default. (Example project.)
bluf: Automatic bank sync that stays off until you turn it on. Your device downloads transactions straight from your bank, and anything shared between your devices is end-to-end encrypted; manual entry stays the default. This fits your priorities and keeps unencrypted money data on your device. Decision needed: approve opt-in, encrypted bank sync?

touched.flip_condition: Cloud features are welcome when they are opt-in and end-to-end encrypted, and manual entry stays the default.
touched.reason: Sync is opt-in, everything that leaves the device is end-to-end encrypted first, and manual entry and file import stay the default for everyone who never turns it on.
Sync is one switch in Settings; the home screen and the add-transaction form do not change.
